title: Divide presentations into articles and sections
goal: Use article to mark content that can be read independently, and use sections and titles to organize the topics in the article.
summary: Neighborhood Newsletter has a notice of the seed exchange meeting, and there is also a section in the notice stating what participants need to bring.
tasks: Change the container with id="seed-swap" to article and retain the h2 title "Seed Exchange Meeting".
Change the container with id="bring" in the article to section, set "What should you bring?" to h3, and keep the following instructions.

example.code:
Trail maintenance record

This week’s progress

The three street signs at the north entrance have been replaced.
example.note: This page already has h1. Use h2 for individual maintenance records and h3 for subsections within the record.

hint: Write </article> after the closing tag of the section. Ending the article early will cause the section to run outside the article.
